l1_rationale: Randomized open-label Phase III BRUIN CLL-313 showed substantial PFS benefit versus bendamustine plus rituximab (HR 0.20; 95% CI 0.11-0.37; p<0.0001) and ORR 94% versus 81%. FDA approval already known, so no blind prediction.
major_risks: Overall survival immature; comparator is chemoimmunotherapy rather than modern covalent BTK targeted treatment; infections hemorrhage cytopenias arrhythmias and hepatotoxicity; serious adverse reactions 28%; application-specific PDUFA goal date unverified
remaining_blocker: Obtain original or amended FDA goal for NDA216059 S-006; do not infer PDUFA goal from October 2 action
